David Amrany Hoier, son of Esther and Harald, was born on the second day of Tishrei 5766 (5 October 2005) in Netanya.

On 18 August 2024 he enlisted in the Israel Police and served in the Border Police.

Staff Sergeant Second Class David Hoier Amrany fell during his service on the 23rd of Elul 5786 (5 September 2026). He was twenty-one years old when he fell. He was laid to rest in the military section of the Even Yehuda cemetery. He is survived by his parents.
